scores.tell: Rover body is smooth uniform plastic with an even gloss, bolts as chunky toy dots, and the moon-ground noise is soft and generic; there is no fine material variation.
Saddle leather has fine stitching, a quiet matte-to-satin range and fine wood grain on the rails. This is nearly the same as the real saddle; the only tell is slightly glossy leather.
Calculator is smooth matte-satin plastic with soft specular edges and no fine texture. It is clean and close to the real cards, but the whole body is evenly lacquered.
Calculator is the same smooth satin plastic. The white keys and blue body are glossy with an even sheen, with little matte variation.
Umbrella canopy is uniformly puffy glossy plastic with no fabric weave, seams or ribs. The pole is a smooth metal tube, so it reads as candy and not cloth.
Flower petals are uniform glossy balloon plastic, and the stones are smooth clay with no grain. The soil has soft noise and the leaves are a smooth satin surface.
Treasure chest has glossy gold with soft highlights and painterly smudged coins. The wood is fine, but the sand grain is a slightly soft AI smear.
Player body is glossy orange plastic with soft clean highlights, and the earbuds are glossy white. The material is consistent, but the whole object is equally lacquered.

Coffin wood has large decorative swooping grain marks and a painterly texture. The grass is a hand-painted blade style, so the surface is a different, more illustrated style than the real smooth 3D cards.
Envelope paper is a smooth matte-satin surface with a soft sheen. The stamp perforations and photo gloss are clean, and the only tell is the slightly glossy paper.
